We are looking for an excellent Software Engineer to join one of Sweden's fastest growing start-ups which is backed by Nvidia, Microsoft and AWS. The company also operates under the Inspection for Strategic Products. Location: Fully remote within India. From 2027 you join our Bangalore office as part of the founding local team  Employment: Full-time, permanent  Start: As soon as you are available About the job Antrino Labs is building the platform that makes every square meter intelligent. The physical world runs on processes nobody can actually see. Goods move, people queue, machines idle, space goes unused, and the decisions made about all of it are based on samples, guesses, and reports written after the fact. Software solved this for the digital world twenty years ago. Everything online is measured, understood, and acted on in real time. The physical world is still dark. We are building the execution layer that closes that gap. Antrino lets any organization deploy vision intelligence into a physical space and get back what is actually happening there — as structured, queryable, real-time information rather than footage. Not a research project, not a custom integration, not a team of ML engineers. A platform, where you describe what matters to you and deploy it. What people build on it is broader than what we designed for. Operators use it to understand processes, find where time and space are being wasted, measure flow and utilization, catch problems while they are still happening, and turn all of it into data good enough to act on. Everything is built on Privacy by Design. Data protection and GDPR compliance are part of the architecture, not a layer added afterwards. We recently closed our Seed round, announced together with Dagens Industri, and we are scaling to meet demand. Antrino Labs is also registered with Inspektionen för strategiska produkter (ISP), the Swedish authority for strategic and dual-use products. The role We are hiring an experienced Software Engineer to join the team building the product itself: the console customers use to connect streams, compose intelligence, and see and act on what comes back. This is a generalist role, and we mean that deliberately. We already have specialists forming around inference, video, and platform infrastructure. What we need alongside them is someone who moves across the whole product without needing a boundary drawn for them: an interface one week, a backend service the next, a database migration the week after, whichever of those actually unblocks the customer in front of us. If you would rather go deep on one layer for a long time, one of our other open roles is probably the better fit. If you want breadth and ownership over correctness end to end, this is it. Concretely, you will work across our Next.js product surfaces and our backend services, shipping features that customers use directly: managing streams and deployments, reviewing events and evidence, understanding usage and cost, and everything else that makes the platform something a team can run their operations through rather than a demo. You will also be one of the people other engineers page when something breaks in an unfamiliar part of the codebase, because you have touched more of it than most. Your main areas of responsibility will include: Building and owning features end to end, across frontend, backend, and the data model underneath them Working on the core product surfaces: stream and deployment management, event and evidence review, usage and cost visibility, and account and project administration Writing and maintaining APIs and services that the rest of the platform, including our specialist teams, build on top of Fixing bugs and resolving production issues wherever they land, rather than only in one part of the stack Participating in code review and architecture discussion across the whole codebase, not just your own corner of it Improving developer tooling, testing, and internal workflows so the team ships with more confidence and less friction Working closely with design and with the founders to turn a rough idea into something shipped and correct Helping onboard and mentor engineers as the team grows, since a generalist background is exactly what a new hire needs early on Our stack You do not need experience with all of this, but you should recognize most of it and be able to argue about it. Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui Backend: TypeScript services alongside Python (FastAPI) services for inference and video Data and auth: Supabase — PostgreSQL with row-level security AI: our own first-party detection models, backed by Anthropic and Google model APIs where a frontier model is the right tool Streaming: RTSP ingestion, RTSP→HLS conversion, live and archive pipelines Infrastructure: Azure, object storage, GitHub Actions, on-site compute reached over Tailscale Who we are looking for Substantial experience as a software engineer on production systems, with real breadth across frontend and backend rather than deep specialization in one Strong TypeScript and modern React, and comfort picking up Python when the problem calls for it Real experience designing APIs, data models, and schemas, including PostgreSQL A track record of picking up unfamiliar parts of a codebase quickly and shipping something correct in them A working understanding of performance, scalability, and where a system is likely to break under load Comfort working directly with product and design, not only with a fully specified ticket You make decisions with incomplete information, take responsibility for the outcome, and say so clearly when something you built was wrong You work well asynchronously across time zones, write clearly, and raise problems early Excellent written and spoken English What we offer Competitive salary, benchmarked to the top of the Indian market for this level and discussed openly early in the process Fully remote within India, with genuine ownership rather than delegated tickets — and a seat in the founding group of our Bangalore office from 2027 Hardware of your choice and a budget for whatever else you need to work well Direct access to founders, to the Stockholm engineering team, and to customers Travel to Stockholm to work with the team in person Process We review applications continuously and contact candidates we think are a good match. An introductory conversation about your background and the role A technical conversation — we discuss systems you have built and how you made the decisions you made. No whiteboard algorithm puzzles A working session with the engineering team on a real problem from our stack A conversation with the founders about ownership, options, and terms References may be requested in the final stage. We aim to keep the process short and to respect your time. Apply with your CV and, if you have one, a link to something you have built. A repository, a shipped product, or a short note about a system you are proud of tells us more than a cover letter.
